findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: leakdata.search, leakdata.protection_summary, leakdata.breach_lookup, leakdata.company_monitoring · Private data: leakdata.search, leakdata.action_plan, leakdata.mark_step_done · Public sink: leakdata.search, leakdata.protection_summary, leakdata.breach_lookup, leakdata.company_monitoring.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: leakdata.search, leakdata.protection_summary, leakdata.breach_lookup, leakdata.company_monitoring · Private data: leakdata.search, leakdata.action_plan, leakdata.mark_step_done · Public sink: leakdata.search, leakdata.protection_summary, leakdata.breach_lookup, leakdata.company_monitoring

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "leakdata.search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
